title: CS 1300 Intraoral Camera Delivers High-quality Images and Supports Patient Communication
html:
Carestream Dental’s CS 1300 intraoral camera is designed to deliver high-quality images that help support patient communication and day-to-day clinical documentation.

Its intuitive handling, rotating head and lighting features help make image capture efficient—while its integration with Carestream’s CS Imaging version 8 and third-party software simplifies workflows.

The camera’s features include a 280° rotating head designed for easy image capture, wide focus range for macro details and broader views, plug-and-play setup for straightforward installation and sharing, and 9 adjustable LED lights that provide consistent illumination with reduced glare. Selectable color-temperature modes allow users to choose their preferred lighting environment.

The camera is fully TWAIN complaint and works with CS Imaging Software as well as other leading imaging software. It is easy to install and connects directly into your laptop or other USB-enabled device with no drivers required. Features include HD imaging, adjustable lighting, one-click image capture, and dual autofocus modes with a broad 10 – 100 mm focus range.

For more information, call (800) 944-6365 or visit carestreamdetal.com.
